meta.title: Stardust
meta.description: Bonfires fill the night with twinkling stars, accompanied by the breeze and the sound of the tides.

units.rawText: Night falls across the beach, but the mood is as fervid as ever. The guerrilla concert at the seaside turns the beach into a field of twinkling stars.

spans.text: What's wrong, Undine?

units.rawText: I've been doing a lot of part-time work recently and barely managed to save up for a new swimsuit, so I thought I'd get the chance to be alone with the Professor...
units.displayText: I've been doing a lot of part-time work recently and barely managed to save up for a new swimsuit, so I thought I'd get the chance to be alone with the Professor...

spans.text: I've been doing a lot of part-time work recently and barely managed to save up for a new swimsuit, so I thought I'd get the chance to be alone with the Professor...

units.rawText: A sly grin spreads across Nanaka's face, and she continues questioning Undine.
units.displayText: A sly grin spreads across Nanaka's face, and she continues questioning Undine.

spans.text: A sly grin spreads across Nanaka's face, and she continues questioning Undine.

units.rawText: Well, the wind is mild and the surf is up, while the bonfire on the ground is matched with the stars in the sky. Isn't this a great chance for you to have a dance with the Professor?
units.displayText: Well, the wind is mild and the surf is up, while the bonfire on the ground is matched with the stars in the sky. Isn't this a great chance for you to have a dance with the Professor?

spans.text: Well, the wind is mild and the surf is up, while the bonfire on the ground is matched with the stars in the sky. Isn't this a great chance for you to have a dance with the Professor?

units.rawText: Dancing?! What kind of dance? With who?!
units.displayText: Dancing?! What kind of dance? With who?!

spans.text: Dancing?! What kind of dance? With who?!

units.rawText: Jiangyu's ears perk up and she immediately inserts herself into the group.
units.displayText: Jiangyu's ears perk up and she immediately inserts herself into the group.

spans.text: Jiangyu's ears perk up and she immediately inserts herself into the group.

units.rawText: With the Professor, of course?
units.displayText: With the Professor, of course?

spans.text: With the Professor, of course?

units.rawText: We're dancing with the Professor? Count me in~
units.displayText: We're dancing with the Professor? Count me in~

spans.text: We're dancing with the Professor? Count me in~

units.rawText: We can do that in these clothes? I thought you needed fancy formal wear for that...
units.displayText: We can do that in these clothes? I thought you needed fancy formal wear for that...

spans.text: We can do that in these clothes? I thought you needed fancy formal wear for that...

units.rawText: Let me think... Since there are so many of us... I think a round dance might be good.
units.displayText: Let me think... Since there are so many of us... I think a round dance might be good.

spans.text: Let me think... Since there are so many of us... I think a round dance might be good.

units.rawText: We'll switch partners between dances so everyone can have a turn with the Professor. That way, we can all have some time alone with them.
units.displayText: We'll switch partners between dances so everyone can have a turn with the Professor. That way, we can all have some time alone with them.

spans.text: We'll switch partners between dances so everyone can have a turn with the Professor. That way, we can all have some time alone with them.

units.rawText: Alone? But... Ack! Nanaka! What are you doing?!
units.displayText: Alone? But... Ack! Nanaka! What are you doing?!

spans.text: Alone? But... Ack! Nanaka! What are you doing?!

units.rawText: Professor~
units.displayText: Professor~

spans.text: Professor~

units.rawText: Nanaka waves to me, then pushes Undine over from behind.
units.displayText: Nanaka waves to me, then pushes Undine over from behind.

spans.text: Nanaka waves to me, then pushes Undine over from behind.

units.rawText: ...D-Don't push me.
units.displayText: ...D-Don't push me.

spans.text: ...D-Don't push me.

units.rawText: Professor, Undine says she would like to dance with you~
units.displayText: Professor, Undine says she would like to dance with you~

spans.text: Professor, Undine says she would like to dance with you~

units.rawText: Oh, really?
units.displayText: Oh, really?

spans.text: Oh, really?

units.rawText: Her face, tinted red by the bonfire, Undine nods dazedly.
units.displayText: Her face, tinted red by the bonfire, Undine nods dazedly.

spans.text: Her face, tinted red by the bonfire, Undine nods dazedly.

units.rawText: Hehe, while I don't think I can manage anything too complicated, simple routines are no problem for me.
units.displayText: Hehe, while I don't think I can manage anything too complicated, simple routines are no problem for me.

spans.text: Hehe, while I don't think I can manage anything too complicated, simple routines are no problem for me.

units.rawText: That's alright, we can teach you. Isn't that right, Undine?
units.displayText: That's alright, we can teach you. Isn't that right, Undine?

spans.text: That's alright, we can teach you. Isn't that right, Undine?

units.rawText: I'll be in your care then, Maestra Undine.
units.displayText: I'll be in your care then, Maestra Undine.

spans.text: I'll be in your care then, Maestra Undine.

units.rawText: The girls launch into a lively round dance, accompanied by elegant music. Each of them gets a turn with me, and a chance to share their innermost feelings amidst the warm firelight.
units.displayText: The girls launch into a lively round dance, accompanied by elegant music. Each of them gets a turn with me, and a chance to share their innermost feelings amidst the warm firelight.

spans.text: The girls launch into a lively round dance, accompanied by elegant music. Each of them gets a turn with me, and a chance to share their innermost feelings amidst the warm firelight.

units.rawText: Thank you for today, Professor... You helped us sell so much and helped us avoid a lot of pitfalls today.
units.displayText: Thank you for today, Professor... You helped us sell so much and helped us avoid a lot of pitfalls today.

spans.text: Thank you for today, Professor... You helped us sell so much and helped us avoid a lot of pitfalls today.

units.rawText: So it's just thanks, then? Then this lovely scenery is a little wasted.
units.displayText: So it's just thanks, then? Then this lovely scenery is a little wasted.

spans.text: So it's just thanks, then? Then this lovely scenery is a little wasted.

units.rawText: In future... Can I spend my summer days with you like this in future? I want to make more memories with you...
units.displayText: In future... Can I spend my summer days with you like this in future? I want to make more memories with you...

spans.text: In future... Can I spend my summer days with you like this in future? I want to make more memories with you...

units.rawText: The girl's voice grows quieter and quieter until her final words sound like a kitten mewing.
units.displayText: The girl's voice grows quieter and quieter until her final words sound like a kitten mewing.

spans.text: The girl's voice grows quieter and quieter until her final words sound like a kitten mewing.

units.rawText: Of course. There's no problem at all.
units.displayText: Of course. There's no problem at all.

spans.text: Of course. There's no problem at all.

units.rawText: Now that I think about it, what happened this morning was a real mess. If only we had thought of this earlier, I'd have picked up these simple steps in an instant.
units.displayText: Now that I think about it, what happened this morning was a real mess. If only we had thought of this earlier, I'd have picked up these simple steps in an instant.

spans.text: Now that I think about it, what happened this morning was a real mess. If only we had thought of this earlier, I'd have picked up these simple steps in an instant.

units.rawText: Mmm...
units.displayText: Mmm...

spans.text: Mmm...

units.rawText: Undine stumbles and falls into my arms.
units.displayText: Undine stumbles and falls into my arms.

spans.text: Undine stumbles and falls into my arms.

units.rawText: ...Hm? Oh no, did I step on your feet just now?
units.displayText: ...Hm? Oh no, did I step on your feet just now?

spans.text: ...Hm? Oh no, did I step on your feet just now?

units.rawText: That's alright. You'll get the hang of it soon enough. But even if you learn from me...
units.displayText: That's alright. You'll get the hang of it soon enough. But even if you learn from me...

spans.text: That's alright. You'll get the hang of it soon enough. But even if you learn from me...

units.rawText: There are nine other talented dance instructors waiting for you. I'm sure your skills will improve by leaps and bounds.
units.displayText: There are nine other talented dance instructors waiting for you. I'm sure your skills will improve by leaps and bounds.

spans.text: There are nine other talented dance instructors waiting for you. I'm sure your skills will improve by leaps and bounds.

units.rawText: Deet-deet-deet, beep-beep—
units.displayText: Deet-deet-deet, beep-beep—

spans.text: Deet-deet-deet, beep-beep—

units.rawText: As the music winds down, a pair of lovely blue eyes remains glued to mine.
units.displayText: As the music winds down, a pair of lovely blue eyes remains glued to mine.

spans.text: As the music winds down, a pair of lovely blue eyes remains glued to mine.

units.rawText: So it's time to change partners, then...
units.displayText: So it's time to change partners, then...

spans.text: So it's time to change partners, then...

units.rawText: Centaureissi bows to me from a place not far off. Seeing this, Undine gently pushes me forward so I arrive in front of her. The music picks up again, and my hand finds its place around Centaureissi's waist, like it's the most natural thing in the world.
units.displayText: Centaureissi bows to me from a place not far off. Seeing this, Undine gently pushes me forward so I arrive in front of her. The music picks up again, and my hand finds its place around Centaureissi's waist, like it's the most natural thing in the world.

spans.text: Centaureissi bows to me from a place not far off. Seeing this, Undine gently pushes me forward so I arrive in front of her. The music picks up again, and my hand finds its place around Centaureissi's waist, like it's the most natural thing in the world.

units.rawText: Nine more, hm...
units.displayText: Nine more, hm...

spans.text: Nine more, hm...

units.rawText: You need to focus more while dancing, Master.
units.displayText: You need to focus more while dancing, Master.

spans.text: You need to focus more while dancing, Master.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Looks like this won't be as easy as I thought. Still...
units.displayText: (Sigh) Looks like this won't be as easy as I thought. Still...

spans.text: (Sigh) Looks like this won't be as easy as I thought. Still...

units.rawText: The gentle breeze is accompanied by the sound of the surf, while the bonfire is matched by the sparkling stars above. Longing and expectation wait in the heart of each of the girls, lit by the dream-like glow of the firelight.
units.displayText: The gentle breeze is accompanied by the sound of the surf, while the bonfire is matched by the sparkling stars above. Longing and expectation wait in the heart of each of the girls, lit by the dream-like glow of the firelight.

spans.text: The gentle breeze is accompanied by the sound of the surf, while the bonfire is matched by the sparkling stars above. Longing and expectation wait in the heart of each of the girls, lit by the dream-like glow of the firelight.

units.rawText: This is a one-of-a-kind summer memory, after all...
units.displayText: This is a one-of-a-kind summer memory, after all...

spans.text: This is a one-of-a-kind summer memory, after all...
